mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.7% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.7% in a month, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in household demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units in a month, it signals a weakening residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 150,000 thousand indicates a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS signal in the low unemployment regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates rising household spending, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflation, which increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
